result.title: Where Does a Weight-Editing Agent Help? Blind Diagnosis and Repair of Deployment Faults in Vision Models
result.summary: Language-model agents can read and edit the weights of neural networks without gradients, and this is increasingly presented as a new way of repairing models. We ask what such an agent adds, in a setting with a known answer. A vision model moved into a new system may be broken by a preprocessing, weight-conversion or output-convention fault; an agent restricted to forward passes must decide whether a fault exists, name it, and undo it by editing the weights. Over 183 runs on classification, segmentation and detection, scored against the fault-free model, we find three things. When the kind of fault is known, the agent is not needed: a script written afterwards repairs 30 of 48 faults against the agent's 33. But the agent did not have to be told: on five fault types outside every script it repairs 15 of 15 where that script repairs 4, and it never edits any of 21 fault-free models. And its limits are predictable: it needs a trustworthy per-layer reference for the model's activations and a fault that is an invertible structured transformation; without them, small faults are missed and repairs stay partial. We derive guidance on when to use an agent and when a script.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在视觉模型部署故障（预处理、权重转换、输出约定错误）场景下，考察仅允许前向传播的语言模型 agent 能否判定、命名并通过改权重修复故障，在分类、分割、检测上共 183 次运行与事后脚本对照，并总结 agent 的适用条件与失效边界。
AI.relevance_reason: 该 agent 靠前向 pass 探测逐层激活、判断故障是否存在并定位，可能为 LVR 中「latent 是否保留必要视觉信息」的诊断、证据获取与停止判断提供可核查线索，但本身不研究推理期 latent 生成。
